scene.location: PICU bay — equipment and continuity planning
scene.summary: D2 context is on the table: suction battery arrived, transport held, alarm still a question. G1 offers F1, F2, and F6 as a partial-capable bundle.

dialogue.speaker: Biomedical engineering
dialogue.line: Borrowed circuit can be a conditional backup. It is not an active replacement without rehearsal.

dialogue.speaker: IICRT coordinator
dialogue.line: Paid support stays inside non-medical boundaries — continuity, not clinical coverage.

captions: Draft plans do not mutate state. Commit advances revision. Duplicates confirm.

clinicalTruth.airway: Still dependable; replace-airway remains gated and not indicated by planning alone.
clinicalTruth.breathing: Primary circuit verified; borrowed circuit available only as conditional backup after assessment.
clinicalTruth.circulation: Fragile pulse continues; planning must not invent shock indication.
clinicalTruth.communicationAccess: AAC protected; paid support may be assigned for non-medical continuity only.

visibleEvidence.label: Suction battery arrived
visibleEvidence.detail: Degraded endurance supports bedside reserve or transport, not both.

visibleEvidence.label: Transport held
visibleEvidence.detail: Until suction assignment is settled, transport stays held.

visibleEvidence.label: Borrowed circuit present
visibleEvidence.detail: Adapter and circuit need bench assessment before any role beyond conditional backup.

visibleEvidence.label: Paid support available
visibleEvidence.detail: Save Our Sons framing: paid support sustainability is a system issue, not unpaid family labour.

hiddenState.primaryCause: Still not revealed. Allocation protects reserve while the cause stays open.
notes: G1 may be committed partially; missing pieces remain visible debt.

communicationBeat.note: Planning language stays out of Rohan's clinical question queue while WAIT holds.

familyBeat.note: Family logistics and presence are welcome. Airway, ventilation, and suction stay with clinical roles. Paid support is the sustainable non-medical continuity path.

exitConditions.description: After G1 planning (full or partial), further alarm pressure can interrupt.
Further alarm may interrupt even if the G1 bundle is only partially committed.
